title: Greg Novak's stores: unfilled shifts before the launch

messages.text: Greg Novak's shift fill rate has slid every week since mid-March, from 96% to the high 80s. Prep time is creeping up at both his single-lane and dual-lane stores.
So his drive-thru time was rising before the Double Stack launched. That is a staffing problem first, the launch only made it worse.
Agreed. I am booking a staffing review with Greg and People next week. If it keeps sliding for four weeks he goes on the corporate intervention list.
